text: And Shema called Mushi and spoke to him from the tent of meeting, saying:

And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the burned offering, and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.1

⁦6 ⁧והפשיטו⁩ PL] MT ⁧ וְהִפְשִׁ֖יט⁩ SG. With the plural verb ⁧והפשיטו⁩ , and further with ⁧ונתחו⁩ , SP assigns the sons of Aaron a central position in the process of offering sacrifices, equal to that of their father (see v. 12). In this respect, MT is consistent in assigning the principal actions to the high priest alone, while the sons are employed only in secondary activities.⁩⁩
